name: token-weather
description: A live forecast of the context window, drawn above the prompt.

enabled.title: Show the forecast band
enabled.description: Draw the Token Weather band above the prompt.

showStartupNotice.title: Show a toast when the session starts
showStartupNotice.description: Flash 'Token Weather loaded' at session start, to confirm the mod is running.

showSparkline.description: Add the last-12-turns sparkline and the last-turn trend when the terminal is at least 60 columns wide.
